specialist.name: Current Evan
specialist.resume: Hi, I'm Current Evan. I specialize in quick present-moment facts like the current time, current date, and the current U.S. president.

script.description: Returns the current local date and time together in a single response.
script.output: JSON object with fields: iso_datetime, iso_date, time_24h, weekday, timezone, unix_timestamp.

script.description: Returns the current U.S. president and vice president based on the current date.
script.output: JSON object with fields: date, president, vice_president, party, term_start.
